field_background_alignment.scope: same-frame exact RGB x0..255, linked SAT bounds masked

actor_overlay_validation.scope: SAT index1 nontransparent native pixels over decoded background, exact RGB against same-frame original screenshot

mosaic.basis: source-qualified absolute render-camera origin + screen coordinate; unwrapped
mosaic.coverage_semantics: zero means unobserved; positive value counts observations
mosaic.conflict_semantics: one means multiple RGB observations disagree
limits: mosaic combines only sampled field frames and captures a bounded portion of the map
unknown pixels are not treated as walls or empty ground

vdp_background_reconstruction.basis: same decoded Genesis Plane A/B/Window background compositor and per-frame CRAM, placed at source-qualified absolute render-camera origins
limits: under-SAT background values are reconstructed from captured VDP planes/patterns and CRAM, not directly visible in the screenshot
pixels conflicting across captures remain flagged and must not be treated as stable

corrections: Horizontal VDP scroll samples screenX minus rawHScroll; zero-scroll snapshots did not qualify sign.
Ring coordinates alias different world rows; absolute source-camera coordinates remove 11414 false mosaic conflicts.
limitations: pixel validation is Genesis decoder versus original screenshots, not NES visual parity
camera coverage audit covers180 captured viewpoints, not all possible player paths
unknown or conflicting pixels do not become passable terrain
NES palette and frozen actor pose are separately declared adaptations
all source patterns, images, states and generated ROMs remain private
post_exit_coverage: Only actually visible source field frames are added; black reentry captures are excluded. Target reentry must wait for an observed viewport.
